messages.subject: HKRUGmeeting[1] <- c()
parts:
As 100% of our member are interested in attending HKRUG meeting, let's organize our 1st meeting in May, shall we?

The history shows that I am a poor organizer. I hope that I can materialize this meeting and I really need your help.

1. Frequency: bimonthly (every two months) or monthly
2. Your preference on weekday / weekend
3. What would you want to do in HKRUG meeting?

Also need your help on the following:

1. Venue, preferable to be free or cheap, with LCD projector
2. Your R expertise, to share your knowledge
3. Any creative ideas

I think I can give a very short talk on data munging or a brief introduction to the data frame.

Thanks

Hong
